zr_skins.zr_d: Basic Scout Fighter, equipped with a high-precision optical system, provides intelligence and firepower support for the troops.
Deadly and swift like a viper, ideal for eliminating key targets. Unlocking to activate: Fighter ATK +5000.
Performs consistently in various battlefield environments, the preferred fighter for experienced commanders. Unlocking to activate: All Hero ATK +5%.

Heavy Attack Aircraft with powerful firepower. Equipped with highly-explosive warheads and a rapid-fire weapon system, designed to destroy fortified targets and enemy clusters. Unlocking to activate: All Hero Skill DMG +2%.
Stealth Tactical Fighter, capable of silently infiltrating enemy lines for assassination and sabotage missions. Unlock to activate: All heroes take -5% DMG.
Ultimate Tactical Weapon Platform, integrating all advanced technologies. Possesses devastating firepower and near-perfect defense. Unlock to activate: +5% enemy Soldier Death Rate in PvP battles.

zr_faq: 1. The Fighter fights at high altitude, continuously attacking enemies and will not be attacked.

2. Combat Training grants Fighter EXP progress. Once it's full, the Fighter levels up and gains stat boosts. In battle, Fighter stats are partially converted into all heroes' stats. The exact conversion ratio can be viewed in the stats details interface.

3. When consuming Combat Chip for training, there's a chance of a Crit:
- If training progress is less than 80%, there's a 50% chance of a Crit, increasing EXP progress by 2x of the consumed Combat Chip.
- If training progress exceeds 80%, no Crit occurs.
- Training with Fighter Parts cannot Crit.
4. Fighter Lv.30/50/70/90/110 increases fighter skill level.
5. The Fighter Component feature unlocks when Base reaches Lv.15. Fighters can equip up to 6 components, significantly enhancing hero stats.

6. On server day 82, Upgrade Fighter and Wingman Plan systems become available. Upgrade Fighter allows further enhancement of Sky Fighter, boosting fighter stats. Upgrade Fighter to Lv.10 to unlock Wingman Plan.
Once the Wingman Plan is unlocked, each plan allows one Initiator, Attack, Support, and Defense Wingman. Before squad battles, you can choose a Wingman Plan to activate the effects during battle. SSR and UR Wingmen can be evolved using duplicates, further enhancing wingman skill effects.
In addition, unused Wingmen can be used to Upgrade Fighter. Each upgrade enhances wingman skill amplification, providing additional stat boosts to Wingmen.
